description: Source code for the XPU (likely a hardware accelerator similar to GPU) memory caching allocator, including classes and functions for managing memory blocks, pools, segments, and virtual memory mapping.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a memory block with associated metadata, including device, size, pointer, and linkage for splitting and merging.

classes.name: SegmentRange
classes.description: Represents a range of virtual memory segments mapped for allocation.

classes.name: ExpandableSegment
classes.description: Manages virtual memory segments that can be expanded and mapped to physical memory.

classes.name: AllocParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for memory allocation requests.

classes.name: PrivatePool
classes.description: Manages a private memory pool, including large and small block pools.

classes.name: DeviceCachingAllocator
classes.description: Main class managing device memory caching, pools, and allocation logic.

methods.name: owner_MempoolId
methods.description: Returns the MempoolId of the owner PrivatePool.

methods.name: allocPrimitive
methods.description: Allocates device memory, either via custom allocator or sycl::aligned_alloc_device.

methods.name: deletePrimitive
methods.description: Frees device memory, either via custom allocator or sycl::free.

methods.name: try_merge_blocks
methods.description: Attempts to merge two adjacent free blocks.

methods.name: get_all_blocks
methods.description: Returns all blocks managed by the allocator.

methods.name: free_block
methods.description: Frees a block and merges with neighbors if possible, updating stats.

methods.name: process_events
methods.description: Processes completed SYCL events and frees associated blocks.

methods.name: round_size
methods.description: Rounds a size to the minimum block size.

methods.name: get_allocation_size
methods.description: Determines the allocation size based on requested size.

methods.name: get_pool
methods.description: Selects the appropriate block pool based on size and queue.

methods.name: find_expandable_block
methods.description: Finds a free block with sufficient virtual address space for expansion.

methods.name: map_block
methods.description: Maps a block to physical memory segments.

methods.name: try_allocate_expandable_block
methods.description: Allocates a block with expandable virtual memory segments.

methods.name: get_free_block
methods.description: Retrieves a free block from the pool matching criteria.

methods.name: alloc_block
methods.description: Allocates a new block, either via expandable segments or primitive allocation.

methods.name: synchronize_and_free_events
methods.description: Synchronizes and frees completed SYCL events.
